label: r4c1
name: roll, 2 epochs, lr 0.002
hypothesis: Same as r2c1, but lr is 0.002 instead of 0.001. Training success was still rising at the end while the learning rate decayed to zero. At 3 epochs, lr 0.002 raised final training success (0.86 against 0.81). Combined with the extra samples from 2 epochs, it should finish more of the learning curve and score above 0.94. Refuted if dev success falls below about 0.90 or a seed collapses.
last_analysis: The observed target is shifted cyclically by X/2. Undoing that shift is the only architecture change that worked: every run with it either reached about 0.85–0.94 dev success or fell to near 0 by seed luck. Fewer PPO epochs helped. 3 epochs gave 0.888 and 2 epochs gave 0.937, the best so far (r2c1). With 1 epoch the agent used only 1x1 bricks, which cannot form overhangs, and scored 0.077. Doubling the learning rate at 3 epochs gave about 0.89, the same as before. Adding the stem features to the footprint head (0.907) was within noise of the best. The main risk is that one seed collapses, either to pressing DONE or to the 1x1-only habit, as with gamma 0.99 and with all x-shifts as input. At 2 epochs r2c1's training success was still rising at the end (0.894 to 0.926), so the agent has not finished learning. Because this is the last round, all three candidates keep r2c1's network and change one recipe setting each.
